label: Bible Study
prompt: Then said Jesus, Father, _____ them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
verse: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
note: The first of Jesus' sayings from the cross — mercy for the very people driving the nails.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Nay, in all these things we are more than _____ through him that loved us.
verse: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
note: Not just conquerors — MORE than conquerors. Paul rounds up even after listing every hardship he can think of.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the _____ of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verse: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
note: Jesus' cure for worry: look at the lilies, which neither toil nor spin and still outdress Solomon.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold upon the mountains the _____ of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
verse: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Judah, keep thy solemn feasts, perform thy vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through thee; he is utterly cut off.
note: Good news for Judah: Nineveh the oppressor is finished — Isaiah 52:7 paints nearly the same picture.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a _____ cymbal.
verse: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
note: Gifts without love are just noise — 'sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.' The KJV calls love 'charity.'
